items.claim: The `transform` op kind's detail and each shape kind's op-factory links named `createTransformOp`, which no longer exists
The Assets page's bundles asset filed editing's presets under `@weasel-js/core`
items.note: `registryData.collectBundles` had the same wrong keying, so both now read one shared list in `drawPresets.ts`.

items.claim: The Assets page left out text-tools: no `text` preset and no `node:text` properties dialog
items.note: It now reads draw's mounted features through the same `DRAW_NODE_PROPERTIES` the registry inspector uses, which moved to `drawPresets.ts`.

items.claim: The Toolkit Builder's URL parser accepted any preset as the base, and non-`tools:` presets as tools (A+B; B added the tools half)
The registry probe's re-render signature left out ambient tools
items.note: The probe and `useToolReflection` now share one `toolSlotsSignature`. Its test checks the shared signature, not the probe's re-render, because the probe's canvas can't change its ambient tools in jsdom.

items.claim: ToolkitBuilder's `.scene` rule lacks the `aspect-ratio` its comment describes
items.note: by deleting the comment rather than restoring the CSS. The ratio was removed on purpose in 28924383fc (2026-10-13): core's `SurfaceCanvas` now sets the canvas to 520×360 from its props, so nothing squishes. Only the comment was wrong. No test, since only a comment changed.

items.claim: The icon detail's "file" row could never render, because the source index is keyed by export name and was searched with the glyph ref
items.note: by removing the dead row. Pointing it at the glyph's `icons/*.mjs` file would need a glyph index the source-index plugin doesn't build. No failing-first test was possible: nothing visible changed.

items.claim: Resolution widget passes the first registry id alphabetically as the active tool, and the signature never notices a tool change
Resolution widget's `key` gesture sends an empty key, so it never matches a binding
Source lookup globs the wrong directories, so no kit symbol resolves and draw's links point at `<root>/src/…`
items.note: Globbing the packages directly would have put about 20 MB of source in the inspector's chunk. Instead, a new Vite plugin serves `virtual:weasel-source-index`, which holds where each export is declared: path, line and JSDoc (about 3.4 MB). It is wired into `apps/draw/vite.config.ts` and into `vitest.config.ts`, in the draw and forge-stories projects. Because it touches `vitest.config.ts`, this commit falls under the fleet triggers, so the batch gets a full run.

items.claim: Properties trait never lists `text`, because the probe reports core's defaults
Draw glyphs that an action also draws are listed twice under one id
The inspector's selected entry is a stale object that never updates when the probe's snapshot arrives
A shape kind's op-factory links navigate to `opFactory`, which no tree category holds
items.note: They now open the matching Ops entries (insert, delete, transform, reparent).

items.claim: A deep link that hasn't resolved yet overrides the user's later pick
Gesture pages and counts ignore 7 of the 16 catalogued gesture kinds
items.note: Removed the dead `GESTURE_CHANNEL_KEYS` along the way.
